svg.title: Marmalade, Nutmeg and Bao — excited jumps
svg.desc: All three selected chef mascots do two hops and wave together. Plays once in 6.6 seconds and respects reduced motion.

svg.title: Marmalade — excited jump and wave
svg.desc: Marmalade does two excited hops, waves, and settles into the original resting pose. The animation plays once in 6.6 seconds. Reduced motion shows the resting pose. Transparent, editable vector artwork with no scripts or external resources.
